answer: The graph is recomputed each epoch, and the scores are published with the graph. A farm's aliases link only to each other, so 362 of them share one low score instead of 362 high ones. A PageRank score is computed from the link graph, so an identity's trust depends on who links to it. Watch the timber: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the bridge bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the harbor audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
